title: Principal correction of a trivially restricted divisor
statement: Let C, k and c be as in lem-sc-pic-restriction-exact [def-sc-curves, lem-sc-compactification]. For a divisor D on c.Z [def-sc-divisor], suppose its point-ideal Picard class [def-sc-picard-group, def-sc-invertible-module] restricts to 1 on C. Then there exists a divisor E on c.Z with Divisor.toPic E = Divisor.toPic D, and with E(P) = 0 at every closed point P whose underlying point lies in the image of c.i. No surjectivity or subgroup-generation assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: Proof: first paragraph, restriction and boundary divisors

proof.text: Use the divisor-class comparison to identify Picard classes with divisors modulo principal divisors on the two smooth connected curves. Restrict D by forgetting the coefficients outside C. Pullback of its point-ideal class is the class of this restricted divisor: at retained points use the point-lifting comparison and at omitted points use boundary triviality; then use finite additivity.

Since the restricted Picard class is 1, the restricted divisor is principal by injectivity of the divisor-class comparison, so it equals div_C(a) for a nonzero rational function a. The open immersion identifies the generic stalks (the function fields), and identifies local rings at all retained closed points, hence their normalized valuations.

Transport a to the common function field of c.Z and form E = D - div_Z(a). Equality of orders on the open curve gives E(P)=0 at every retained point. The divisor div_Z(a) is principal, hence its toPic class is zero by the class equivalence; thus E and D have identical toPic classes. Their supports are finite by Noetherianity. If the boundary is empty, E is zero.

from.place: Affine case: restriction from the smooth compactification and the boundary kernel

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.pic_restriction_divisor_correction
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g]
    [hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 c.g]
    (D : c.Z.Divisor)
    (hD : Scheme.Pic.mapHom c.i
      (@Scheme.Divisor.toPic k _ c.Z ⟨c.g⟩ hsm D).toMul = 1) :
    ∃ E : c.Z.Divisor,
      @Scheme.Divisor.toPic k _ c.Z ⟨c.g⟩ hsm E =
        @Scheme.Divisor.toPic k _ c.Z ⟨c.g⟩ hsm D ∧
      ∀ P : closedPoints c.Z, P.val ∈ Set.range c.i.base → E P = 0
